cases.name: back to the GNU-only word boundary
caught_by: a keyword import with nothing quoted counts: exit 1, wanted 0

cases.name: no boundary after the stem at all
caught_by: a module whose name only starts with the stem is not an import: exit 0, wanted 1

cases.name: the boundary admits an underscore
caught_by: a module whose name only starts with the stem is not an import: exit 0, wanted 1
